entries.header: theorem M7.Presentation.targetLeast_spec : ∀ (κ σ τ X Y : Type) [LinearOrder κ] [LinearOrder σ] [LinearOrder τ] (K : Finset κ) (S : Finset σ) (T : Finset τ) (l : κ → σ → X) (r : κ → τ → Y) (q : X × Y), (∀ a : M7.Presentation.Record κ σ τ, M7.Presentation.targetLeast K S T l r q = some a ↔ a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T ∧ M7.Presentation.realize l r a = q ∧ ∀ b ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T, M7.Presentation.realize l r b = q → a ≤ b) ∧ (M7.Presentation.targetLeast K S T l r q = none ↔ ¬ ∃ a ∈ M7.Presentation.domain K S T, M7.Presentation.realize l r a = q)
